chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Asbaat, from the one who reported it, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
There is no problem if there happen to be twenty shirts for the man.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to own many shirts according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi’s chapter on dress, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that owning up to twenty shirts is permissible (la ba'sa), reflecting a moderate approach to material accumulation rather than strict asceticism. It highlights the Shia juristic principle of distinguishing between mere possession and the vice of extravagance (israf), allowing for practical comfort while maintaining spiritual discipline.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from the one who reported it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is no problem if there happen to be twenty shirts for the man’.
en.sarwar: 16. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbat from the one who narrated to him who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is not unlawful if one has twenty shirts. 5 ”
